name: PM Carousel + Tobii Lightbox
description: Use the Tobii lightbox with PM Carousel.
project_description:
Integration of Tobii lightbox with the PM Carousel accessible slider.

 
 A submodule is available to handle responsive images. 
 Another submodule is available to handle media image entities. 
 
 Requirements 
 
 The PM Carousel javascript library (check below for installation details) 
 The Tobii javascript library (check below for installation details) 
 PM Carousel Accessible Slider module. 
 Lightbox Tobii Image Formatter module. 
 
 PM Carousel javascript library 
 The PM Carousel library must be installed in the /web/libraries/pm-carousel folder of your Drupal installation.

 The module requires the following file to be available:

 
 /libraries/pm-carousel/dist/pm-carousel.umd.js 
 
 The library files will be automatically installed from our mirror fork when using composer .

 Tobii javascript library 
 The Tobii library must be installed in the /web/libraries/tobii folder of your Drupal installation.

 The module requires the following files to be available:

 
 /libraries/tobii/dist/tobii.umd.js 
 /libraries/tobii/dist/tobii.min.css 
 
 The library files will be automatically installed from our mirror fork when using composer .

 Examples 
 Here are some web pages where PM Carousel with Tobii is implemented:
